faqs: Can the VR/CBT modules be customised for our plant or equipment?
Yes. We develop bespoke training simulations based on your SOPs, 3D environments and plant layout.
Do you provide hardware for VR training?
We can supply, recommend or integrate with your existing devices (Meta Quest, HTC Vive, etc.).
How do you measure learning outcomes or safety awareness?
Our system tracks user performance, scores, error rates and completion, with analytics dashboards for HR or EHS leads.
How long does deployment take?
VR/CBT modules can typically be deployed in 2–4 weeks, depending on content complexity.

faqs: What is smart labelling, and how does it work?
Smart labelling uses QR codes, OCR, metal tags or GPS identifiers to digitise every asset for instant data access via phone, tablet or smart glasses.
Can we store our data on our servers instead of yours?
Yes. We support hybrid cloud setups — sensitive data can remain on your on-prem server, and general data on ours.
Does it work offline in remote or offshore locations?
Yes. Offline syncing is supported for field conditions like offshore rigs or warehouses with weak connectivity.

faqs: What types of violations or analytics can your AI detect?
PPE compliance, zone breach, unsafe acts, idle time, KPI performance and quality defects via camera feeds or drone input.
Is facial recognition secure and compliant with regulations?
Yes. We follow PDPA (Singapore) and GDPR (EU) guidelines. Facial data is anonymised and encrypted.
Can we use existing CCTV infrastructure for AI analytics?
Absolutely. AiVA is compatible with most IP cameras and requires minimal additional setup.
